extracted.intended_audience: NIH peer reviewers, Scientific Review Officers, and investigators submitting NIH grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Collection of NIH policies, procedures, and resources governing peer review of research grant applications, including review criteria, conflict-of-interest rules, human subjects protections, scoring procedures, and administrative forms. Intended to guide reviewers and applicants on conduct and evaluation standards used across NIH study sections and advisory councils.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of the Peer Review Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes the multi-step NIH peer review process: initial peer review by Scientific Review Groups (SRGs/study sections) managed by Scientific Review Officers (SROs), with second-level review by NIH National Advisory Councils or Boards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains roles of CSR and IC review branches in managing SRGs and the role of advisory councils to provide cross-section public advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rosters of Scientific Review Groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Availability and use of rosters listing membership of NIH Scientific Review Groups.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rosters provide transparency on SRG composition and are linked for reviewer/applicant reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhancing Peer Review at NIH (2007-2008 Self-Study)
rubrics_metrics.description: Final draft diagnostic report on NIH peer review enhancement efforts (NIH 2007–2008 Peer Review Self-Study).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context document for changes to peer review policies and criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Side-by-Side Comparison of Enhanced and Former Review Criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: Comparative document showing differences between updated (enhanced) and previous NIH review criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for reviewers and applicants to understand what changed in evaluation standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Announces Updated Criteria for Evaluating Research Grant Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Announcement and documentation of updated criteria NIH uses to evaluate research grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supported by comparison and Q&A documents linked on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Questions and Answers about the Updated NIH Criteria for Evaluating Research Grant Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Q&A resource clarifying the updated NIH evaluation criteria for applicants and reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides explanatory detail and interpretation of the updated criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: General guidance for reviewers on how to perform peer review of NIH grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes expectations for reviewer conduct and review content (linked resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for Review of Specific Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Specialized guidance addressing review considerations for particular application types or subject areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points reviewers to tailored criteria or procedures when reviewing nonstandard or specialized proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of New Investigator R01s
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on evaluating R01 applications submitted by new investigators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses issues specific to assessing early-stage investigators (linked PDF resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: CSR Scoring Procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural guidance describing how scoring is carried out by the Center for Scientific Review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides instructions on score assignment, use of numeric scores, and summary statements (linked PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Best Practice Guidelines for Accepting Additional Grant Application Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Best-practice guidance on when and how to accept supplemental materials submitted with grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains permissible additional materials and the process for submission/acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Policy on Submission of Additional Grant Application Materials (NOT-OD-08-082)
rubrics_metrics.description: Official NIH policy notice governing submission of additional materials with grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regulatory/administrative rules that implement the best-practice guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict Of Interest, Confidentiality And Non-Disclosure Rules For NIH Peer Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and information for reviewers concerning conflicts of interest, confidentiality obligations, and non-disclosure when reviewing grant applications and R&D/contract proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes pre- and post-review certification forms and links to OER Conflict of Interest page; sets behavioral and disclosure standards for reviewers (PDF/MS Word links).

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Pre-Review Certification Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Form used to certify reviewer eligibility and disclose conflicts before participation in peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative requirement to document conflicts and adherence to confidentiality prior to review.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Post-Review Certification Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Form used to certify compliance with peer review rules and confidentiality after completing review duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Administrative record of reviewer conduct and confidentiality obligations following review.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Instructions to Reviewers for Evaluating Research Involving Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions to guide reviewers in assessing human subjects protections and ethical considerations in grant and cooperative agreement applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses how human subjects protections should factor into the overall evaluation of applications (linked PDF).

rubrics_metrics.name: Important Notice to Applicants: Requirements for Human and Animal Subjects Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice outlining applicant responsibilities and requirements for proposals involving human and/or animal subjects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies compliance expectations and documentation needed for review and funding decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Decision Trees for Human Subject Protection and Inclusion Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Decision-tree tools to help reviewers and administrators determine outcomes regarding human subject protections and inclusion criteria.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational aids for consistent decision-making on human subjects/inclusion issues during review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Humans (document)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resource addressing protection of human research participants in grant applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Linked as PDF/PowerPoint; supports reviewer assessment of human subjects protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion Policies: Women, Minorities, and Children in Clinical Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents providing policies and guidance on inclusion of women, minorities, and children in clinical research and NIH-defined Phase III clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple linked PDFs/PowerPoints covering inclusion expectations and analysis for clinical studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data and Safety Monitoring Plans in Clinical Trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance regarding requirements and expectations for data and safety monitoring plans in clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains what review committees should look for in monitoring plans and related protections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of Research Involving Natural Products Usually Prepared as Complex Mixtures
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for reviewing research involving natural product mixtures, which may present unique evaluation issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses special review considerations for complex mixtures (linked resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: Modular Grant Application and Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on modular budget formats and related review/award processes for applicable NIH grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how modular budget applications are prepared and considered in review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resources for New Investigators
rubrics_metrics.description: Materials and guidance intended to help new investigators prepare competitive applications and understand review expectations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes resources to clarify how new investigators are evaluated and supported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission and Assignment Process
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural information on how grant applications are submitted and assigned to SRGs or IC review branches.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains administrative routing that affects which reviewers and criteria apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals of Initial Scientific Peer Review
rubrics_metrics.description: Policies and procedures governing appeals by applicants of initial peer review decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains eligible grounds for appeal and the process for requesting review reconsideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Regulations (42 CFR Part 52h)
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal regulations that govern the scientific peer review of research grant applications and research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes Final Rules and Federal Register notice; provides the legal/regulatory framework for NIH peer review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Notes (CSR publication)
rubrics_metrics.description: CSR publication summarizing new developments related to NIH review policies and procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Newsletter/resource to keep reviewers informed of policy changes and practice updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review Archive
rubrics_metrics.description: Archived collection of peer review policies and practices documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical resource for prior versions of policies and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Letter to Members of the NIH Community of Peer Reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Communication to NIH reviewers outlining expectations, changes, or appeals for participation and conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual communication aimed at clarifying reviewer responsibilities and NIH priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH Grant Review Process Video
rubrics_metrics.description: Multimedia resource explaining the NIH grant review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational aid for reviewers and applicants to understand review workflow and expectations.
